context.body: Material provision culminates in a request for enduring desire and faithful action.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: David praises God as giver of kingdom, riches, and strength, says the people have given what already belongs to God, and asks for Solomon to receive a whole heart to obey and build.
observations.label: David asks for Solomon’s whole heart: action

observations.body: The assembly’s generosity is interpreted as divine gift and becomes the setting for prayer about Solomon’s inner loyalty.
observations.label: David asks for Solomon’s whole heart: response

observations.body: all things come from you · offered willingly · prepare their heart · Solomon my son
observations.label: Words in 1 Chronicles 29:10–19

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 29:10–19 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer asks for the whole heart whose later division becomes central to Solomon’s story.
payload.title: David asks for Solomon’s whole heart
